def.short: an electric machine at home that cleans your clothes with water and soap
def.long: An electric machine that cleans clothes, towels and sheets with water and soap. You load it, turn it on and take the clothes out when it finishes.

grammar.pattern: put sth in / take sth out of the washing machine

examples.en: The washing machine is making a strange noise.
examples.tr: Çamaşır makinesi garip bir ses çıkarıyor.

examples.en: Selin put her jeans in the washing machine.
examples.tr: Selin kotunu çamaşır makinesine koydu.

examples.en: Can you take the wet clothes out of the washing machine, please?
examples.tr: Islak çamaşırları çamaşır makinesinden çıkarabilir misin lütfen?

tr.note: Çamaşır yıkamak 'do the laundry' olur. Bulaşık makinesine ise 'dishwasher' denir.

quiz.cloze: My clothes are dirty, so I'll put them in the ______.

entries.sense_note: bend clothes neatly into a shape

def.micro: bend cloth into a neat shape
def.short: bend clothes or paper so one part lies on top of the other
def.long: To bend a piece of clothing, a towel or paper so that one part lies flat on top of another part. People do this to make things neat and small.

examples.en: Ana folded the clean towels.
examples.tr: Ana temiz havluları katladı.

examples.en: Please fold your shirts and put them in the drawer.
examples.tr: Lütfen gömleklerini katla ve çekmeceye koy.

examples.en: Liam folded the letter in half and put it in an envelope.
examples.tr: Liam mektubu ikiye katladı ve bir zarfa koydu.

tr.note: 'Fold in half' ikiye katlamak demek. Bilgisayardaki 'folder' (klasör) de aynı kökten gelir.

quiz.cloze: The clean towels are on the bed. Can you ______ them and put them in the cupboard?

entries.sense_note: put clothes on a hook or hanger

def.micro: put on a hook or hanger
def.short: put a coat or other clothes on a hook or a hanger
def.long: To put a coat, shirt or other clothes on a hook or a hanger, so they stay neat. Put 'it' or 'them' between 'hang' and 'up': hang it up.

grammar.pattern: hang sth up / hang up sth

examples.en: Hang up your coat, please.
examples.tr: Lütfen montunu as.

examples.en: Omar hung up his jacket behind the door.
examples.tr: Omar ceketini kapının arkasına astı.

examples.en: Deniz ironed her dress and hung it up in the wardrobe.
examples.tr: Deniz elbisesini ütüledi ve gardıroba astı.

tr.note: 'Hang up' telefonu kapatmak demek de olabilir; burada ise ceket ya da kıyafet asmak anlamında. Zamir araya girer: 'hang it up' denir, 'hang up it' denmez.

quiz.cloze: Please ______ your coat on the hook by the door.

entries.sense_note: prepare the table for a meal

def.micro: get the table ready to eat
def.short: put plates, glasses, forks and knives on the table before a meal
def.long: To put plates, glasses, forks, knives and spoons on the table before people eat. In British English, people also say 'lay the table'.

examples.en: Can you set the table, please?
examples.tr: Sofrayı kurar mısın lütfen?

examples.en: Mehmet set the table while his wife cooked dinner.
examples.tr: Karısı akşam yemeğini pişirirken Mehmet sofrayı kurdu.

examples.en: The kids set the table for six because their grandparents were coming.
examples.tr: Dedeleriyle nineleri geleceği için çocuklar sofrayı altı kişilik kurdu.

tr.note: İngiliz İngilizcesinde 'lay the table' da denir. Yemekten sonra sofrayı toplamak ise 'clear the table' olur.

quiz.cloze: Dinner is almost ready. Can you ______ for four people?

entries.sense_note: take dishes away after a meal

def.short: take the plates, glasses and food away from the table after eating
def.long: To take the dirty plates, glasses and food away from the table when everyone has finished eating. It is often a job for children at home.

examples.en: I'll clear the table after dinner.
examples.tr: Yemekten sonra sofrayı ben toplarım.

examples.en: Selin cleared the table and put the plates in the sink.
examples.tr: Selin sofrayı topladı ve tabakları lavaboya koydu.

examples.en: In our house, whoever cooks doesn't have to clear the table.
examples.tr: Bizim evde yemeği yapan sofrayı toplamak zorunda değil.

tr.note: Yemekten önce sofrayı kurmak 'set the table', yemekten sonra toplamak 'clear the table' olur.

mistakes.why: 'Toplamak' çoğu zaman 'collect' diye çevrilir, ama sofra için 'clear' kullanılır: tabakları kaldırıp masayı boşaltmak demek.

quiz.cloze: We've finished dinner. Can you help me ______? Put the plates in the sink.

entries.sense_note: damage food or skin with heat

def.short: damage food by cooking it too long, or hurt your skin on something hot
def.long: To damage food by cooking it for too long, or to hurt your skin on something very hot. The past form is 'burned', and in British English also 'burnt'.

grammar.pattern: burn sth; burn your hand / finger

examples.en: Oh no, I burned the toast!
examples.tr: Eyvah, ekmeği yaktım!

examples.en: Mehmet burned his hand on the hot pan.
examples.tr: Mehmet elini sıcak tavada yaktı.

examples.en: Turn the heat down, or you'll burn the rice.
examples.tr: Ocağın altını kıs, yoksa pilavı yakacaksın.

tr.note: Geçmiş zaman: Amerikan İngilizcesinde 'burned', İngiliz İngilizcesinde 'burnt' de olur. 'Burnt toast' yanık ekmek demek.

quiz.cloze: I forgot the pizza in the oven, and I ______ it. It's black now.

entries.sense_note: kitchen box for baking and roasting

def.micro: a hot box for cooking food
def.short: a kitchen machine like a box with a door, used for baking and cooking food
def.long: A kitchen machine shaped like a box with a door. It gets very hot inside, and you use it to bake bread and cakes or to cook meat and vegetables.

examples.en: The cake is in the oven.
examples.tr: Kek fırında.

examples.en: Liam turned on the oven before he made the pizza.
examples.tr: Liam pizzayı yapmadan önce fırını açtı.

examples.en: Be careful! The oven door is very hot.
examples.tr: Dikkat et! Fırının kapağı çok sıcak.

collocations: take sth out of the oven

tr.note: Türkçede 'fırın' hem mutfaktaki fırın hem de ekmek satılan dükkân demek. Mutfaktaki fırın 'oven', ekmek fırını ise 'bakery' olur. Mikrodalga 'microwave' denir.

mistakes.wrong: I bought fresh bread from the oven.
mistakes.right: I bought fresh bread from the bakery.
mistakes.why: Türkçede ekmek alınan dükkâna da 'fırın' denir. İngilizcede o dükkân 'bakery' olur; 'oven' yalnızca pişirme makinesidir.

quiz.cloze: Heat the ______ to 180 degrees, then put the cake in.

def.micro: a shelf unit with a door
def.short: a piece of furniture with doors and shelves, used for plates, cups and food
def.long: A piece of furniture with a door and shelves inside, often on a kitchen wall. People keep plates, cups and food in it. In the US, people often say 'cabinet'.

examples.en: The cups are in the cupboard.
examples.tr: Fincanlar dolapta.

examples.en: Omar put the clean plates back in the cupboard.
examples.tr: Omar temiz tabakları dolaba geri koydu.

examples.en: There's a bag of rice in the cupboard above the sink.
examples.tr: Lavabonun üstündeki dolapta bir paket pirinç var.

tr.note: 'p' harfi okunmaz: 'kabırd' gibi söylenir. Giysi dolabı ise 'wardrobe' olur. Amerikan İngilizcesinde mutfak dolabına çoğu zaman 'cabinet' denir.

quiz.cloze: The plates are in the ______. Open the door on the left.

entries.sense_note: box in furniture that slides out

def.micro: a box that slides in and out
def.short: a box in a desk, table or cupboard that you pull out to open
def.long: A box inside a desk, table or other furniture that slides in and out. You pull it open to put things in or take things out, like spoons, socks or papers.

examples.en: The forks are in that drawer.
examples.tr: Çatallar şu çekmecede.

examples.en: Deniz keeps her socks in the top drawer.
examples.tr: Deniz çoraplarını en üst çekmecede tutuyor.

examples.en: I looked in every drawer in the kitchen, but I couldn't find the scissors.
examples.tr: Mutfaktaki bütün çekmecelere baktım ama makası bulamadım.

tr.note: Çoğu zaman tek hece gibi söylenir: Amerikan İngilizcesinde /drɔːr/, İngiliz İngilizcesinde /drɔː/. 'Chest of drawers' çekmeceli dolap, şifonyer demek.

quiz.cloze: The spoons are in the top ______ next to the oven. Just pull it open.

def.short: a bowl with taps in a kitchen or bathroom, used for washing dishes or hands
def.long: A large bowl fixed to the wall or a counter, with taps for water. You wash dishes in the kitchen sink and wash your hands in the bathroom sink.

examples.en: Don't leave dirty plates in the sink.
examples.tr: Kirli tabakları lavaboda bırakma.

examples.en: Ana washed the vegetables in the kitchen sink.
examples.tr: Ana sebzeleri mutfak lavabosunda yıkadı.

examples.en: Kaan filled the sink with hot water and soap.
examples.tr: Kaan lavaboyu sıcak su ve sabunla doldurdu.

tr.note: Mutfaktaki lavabo (evye) de banyodaki lavabo da 'sink' olur. Türkçedeki 'lavaboya gitmek' (tuvalete gitmek) için ise 'go to the toilet' ya da 'go to the bathroom' denir.

quiz.cloze: Wash your hands in the ______ before dinner.
